name: Solikamsk-Gubdor-Cherdyn Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (northern Perm Krai, stage 1)

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: CB 2026-09-30: route not drawn. Corridor named by sources: GRS Solikamsk - Gubdor - Berezovaya Starica - Ryabinino - Seregovo - Cherdyn; crosses the Kolva and Vishera (HDD), a federal road, marsh and rocky terrain. Candidate for the routes leg (endpoints + named villages).

researcher_notes: No existing GEM row covers northern Perm Krai (roster has only Nizhnyaya Tura-Perm-Gorky trunks, P2351/P5712/P5714-5716). Threshold met: sponsor = Gazprom (Perm Krai programme 2021-2025; Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Perm / Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Perm AO run it, per ugaz.ru); endpoints sourced; concrete step = built and gas launched 16-20 Sept 2026. LENGTH 104.5 km: contractor Severnaya Kompaniya (nordcompany.ru/proekty, 'Межпоселковый газопровод протяженностью 104,5 км ГРС Соликамск - ... - г. Чердынь', design + construction); corroborated by RBC Perm 2025-12-26 and ugaz.ru (both 'свыше/превышает 100 км'). NOT the 209 km (trunk plus distribution networks, progorod59/59i) nor the ~170 km Kommersant 2022 programme figure (Solikamsk-Krasnovishersk-Cherdyn, planned). STATUS operating: 59i.ru 16 Sep 2026 and neperm.ru 20 Sep 2026 report network gas arrived in Cherdyn, Gubdor, Seregovo, Berezovaya Starica, Ryabinino; official acceptance had been planned after RBC's Dec 2025 completion report, so operating is from the gas-launch reports. ProposalYear 2022 (Kommersant 2 Sep 2022: Gazprom-Perm agreement June 2022 added the line to the programme; start of detailed design inferred). ConstructionYear 2024: ugaz.ru Jan 2024 reports pipe under construction with first 3 km laid; Dec 2025 report says build took about 1.5 years (first weld ~mid 2024). Months not sourced, left blank. LEFT BLANK, nothing sourced: Diameter, Capacity, Pressure, Cost, PipelineType (inter-settlement trunk fed from a GRS; transmission vs distribution is a reviewer call), Owner/Parent (candidate: Gazprom PJSC as programme funder, Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Perm AO as operator; entity_lookup shows Gazprom PJSC exists, Perm operator not in tracker; owner refs belong on the operators/owners tab, not staged). NOTES-ONLY, not rows: stage 2 Cherdyn-Pokcha-Ezova-Vilgort-Kangort-Bigichi-Iskor-Nyrob and stage 3 Gubdor-Nizhnyaya Yazva-Krasnovishersk (business-class.su 2024-01-25; no lengths found; new 2026-2030 Gazprom Perm programme per neftegaz.ru). Possible overlap to adjudicate: Kommersant's single Solikamsk-Krasnovishersk-Cherdyn >170 km object was split into stages, so stage 3 length is roughly 170 - 104.5 minus stage 2, unsourced. Perm rbc.ru and permkrai.ru pages sometimes slow/blocked; permkrai.ru construction-start release timed out and was not cited.
